points: The upcoming Q3 2026 print could confirm AMD hit its $13.0B revenue and $6.5B data-center guidance, and the Q4 outlook will show whether the 31% operating margin holds as Helios begins shipping.

Helios rack-scale systems shipping in Q3 2026 and Microsoft Azure deployments starting now could pull new orders into Q4 and early 2027, keeping data-center growth well above the 50% YoY threshold that defines the bull case.

MI450 GPU shipments to Meta and other hyperscalers in the second half of 2026 could add a new revenue layer on top of the already-estimated $7-8B Instinct GPU revenue this fiscal year, supporting the push toward roughly 10% AI accelerator share in 2026.

The $800M MI308X inventory writedown and $1.5B in lost China sales are already factored in; if the next print shows export controls are not spreading to MI450 or Helios, the risk premium around the stock could shrink and the long case would strengthen.

AMD is targeting 50% server-CPU share while guiding data-center revenue to $6.5B in Q3, so if EPYC momentum continues into Q4 the core CPU business can help offset any volatility in AI accelerator demand.

If data-center revenue growth stays above 50% YoY and operating margin stays above 25% through the next two quarters, the 2026 AI accelerator share target looks achievable and the main falsifiers lose force.

Gaining AI accelerator share from roughly 5% in 2024 toward roughly 10% in 2026, against NVIDIA's roughly 80% position, means AMD's data-center business can keep expanding faster than the broader semiconductor group while the computer industry theme remains active.

The next print could also reveal whether the China licensing rules that took effect May 31, 2026 are denting Q3 demand or merely shifting shipments to other regions, which matters because the long thesis depends on diversified hyperscaler demand, not China alone.
If the Q3 report shows operating margin compressing toward 25% or data-center growth slowing below 50% YoY, the constructive long stance would break and the position would need to be reassessed.
